notes.title: 60% Price Cut
notes.content:
[h3]Great news guys! [/h3]

[b]We're cutting the price by 60%![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382746/74ffb3a7fa195ea9343140b1d72492844084524b.gif[/img]

Also we brought some quality of life improvements to this update:

[list]

[/list]

Hope you'll love it!
Have fun!

notes.title: New Feature Update!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382746/74ffb3a7fa195ea9343140b1d72492844084524b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382746/74ffb3a7fa195ea9343140b1d72492844084524b.gif[/img][/url][h3]Hello Rushers! 
We're excited to announce a new update that you're going to love![/h3]ːsteamhappyː

[b][list]
[*]Added Character Customization!
[*]Added Offline Mode!
[/list][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382746/66bf84bcd20af1ff96f35dc8549f8b0c423ddcde.png[/img]

We'd be happy to hear your thoughts in the comments. Don't hesitate to reach out.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b][h3]New Feature Update!
[/h3][/b]
[b][h3]Additions:[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Your progress now is saved, and you can continue playing anytime you want
[*] No more stuck situations, you can use a checkpoint if got into such situation
[*] Server Code now can be also showed instead of only having the possibility to copy it
[*] Show Tips while loading into the game
[*] Display how many players are on the server
[/list]
[b][h3]Changes:[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Level Design changes and optimization
[*] Casino Sector upgrade
[/list]

notes.title: PRICE DROP AND FEATURE UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear RUSH Community,

We're thrilled to roll out the latest update for RUSH: RUN UP SUPER HIGH. Your experience and joy are at the heart of what we do, and every change reflects our commitment to you.

[h3] Update Highlights: 🌟
[/h3][list]
[*]🟠[b]50% PRICE DROP [/b]- To celebrate this update and make RUSH more accessible to all, we're offering the game at half its price. This one's for you!
[*]🟠[b]Checkpoint System[/b] - No more losing all that hard-earned progress! Teleport back with checkpoints after slip-ups, with a brief time penalty.
[*][b]Enhanced Co-op Gameplay[/b] - Team adventures are now more thrilling. Fall behind? Use checkpoints to swiftly reunite with your friends.
[*][b]Refined Character Controls [/b]- Experience smoother, more intuitive gameplay with our revamped controls.
[*][b]Level Design Improvements[/b] - Say goodbye to those frustrating stuck points, and hello to a more streamlined adventure.
[/list]
Your continuous feedback and support inspire us to keep enhancing RUSH. Together, let's keep the momentum going and reach even greater heights! 🚀🌟

With gratitude, 
RUSH Team
